name: Bodyweight Squat
cues: Feet shoulder-width; sit back into hips; knees track over toes

name: Chair-Assisted Squat
cues: Tap the chair lightly; keep chest up; drive through heels

name: Glute Bridge
cues: Squeeze glutes at the top; don't arch the lower back

name: Reverse Lunge
cues: Step back; front knee over ankle; push through front heel

name: Step-Ups
cues: Full foot on the step; control the way down

name: Wall Push-Up
cues: Body in one line; elbows about 45 degrees from ribs

name: Incline Push-Up
cues: Higher surface = easier; keep core tight

name: Knee Push-Up
cues: Hips in line with shoulders and knees

name: Bent-Over Row (Band)
cues: Pull elbows toward hips; squeeze shoulder blades

name: Bent-Over Row (Dumbbell)
cues: Flat back; pull to the waist not the chest

name: Lat Pulldown (Band)
cues: Anchor high; pull elbows down and back

name: Overhead Press (Dumbbell)
cues: Ribs down; press without leaning back

name: Lateral Raise
cues: Lead with elbows; stop at shoulder height

name: Bicep Curl
cues: Elbows pinned to sides; control the lowering

name: Tricep Kickback
cues: Upper arm still; extend only the forearm

name: Plank
cues: Straight line ear to ankle; breathe; don't sag hips

name: Knee Plank
cues: Same line from knees; squeeze glutes

name: Side Plank (Knees)
cues: Stack shoulders; lift hips; hold steady

name: Dead Bug
cues: Lower back pressed down; slow opposite arm and leg

name: Bird Dog
cues: Long spine; reach without rotating hips

name: Cat-Cow
cues: Move with the breath; segment the spine

name: Child's Pose
cues: Knees wide; sink hips back; long arms

name: Hip Flexor Stretch
cues: Tall posture; gentle forward shift; no pain

name: Hamstring Stretch
cues: Soft knee; hinge from the hip

name: Thoracic Rotation
cues: Follow the moving hand with your eyes

name: Brisk Walk
cues: Pace where you can talk but not sing

name: Incline Walk
cues: Lean slightly forward from ankles; relaxed arms

name: Cycling (Easy)
cues: Smooth cadence; conversational effort

name: Marching in Place
cues: Lift knees to hip height; swing arms

name: Low-Impact Jumping Jack
cues: Step side-to-side instead of jumping

name: Stair Climb
cues: Use the rail if needed; steady breathing

name: Farmer's Carry
cues: Tall posture; ribs stacked over hips; grip firm

name: Kettlebell Deadlift
cues: Hinge at hips; flat back; stand tall

name: Wall Sit
cues: Thighs toward parallel; breathe through the hold

name: Calf Raise
cues: Pause at the top; lower slowly

name: Superman Hold
cues: Lift chest and thighs gently; look down

name: Shoulder Taps
cues: Wide feet; minimal hip sway

name: Standing Balance (Single Leg)
cues: Soft knee; eyes on a fixed point

name: Box Breathing
cues: Inhale 4 - hold 4 - exhale 4 - hold 4

name: Legs Up the Wall
cues: 5 to 10 minutes; slow nasal breathing
